second_path.note: SINGLE PATH.  Restored to the honest reading of RECEIPT_R148_J72.md sec 3, which recorded: 'second_path currently empty -- the facet recursion is itself the second method for Sigma_9 relative to the trace route, but {7,2} as a single class has no third-party cross-check.'  A later revision labelled this 'pre-registered-identity', citing C_9 + {7,2} = -75863/302400.  AUDIT_R177 2.5 rejected that: the identity has TWO facet-side unknowns, it was pre-registered from the trace-route side, and it was already SPENT certifying C_9 (whose target it pinned, given the earlier-delivered {7,2}).  One equation cannot independently confirm both of its own terms.  The second identity {5,4}+{2,2,5}+C_9+{7,2} = Sigma_9 has four facet-side unknowns and constrains only their sum.  {7,2} therefore stands on the facet chain alone, exactly like {2,2,5}, {5,4} and {6,2,2}.  The value itself is unaffected and remains gate-checked by g_be BE7.
